signature.name: National Pantheon of Venezuela
signature.detail: The country's most important memorial, where Simon Bolivar is buried, and the top landmark for first-time visitors. Go in the morning on a weekday to avoid crowds, and dress modestly since it is a working national shrine.

signature.name: Birthplace of Simon Bolivar
signature.detail: A restored colonial house museum in the old center that shows where the liberator was born. It is a short walk from Plaza Bolivar, so pair the two in one outing; check opening hours before you go as they can be limited.

signature.name: Plaza Bolivar
signature.detail: The historic heart of the old town, ringed by colonial buildings and close to the cathedral. Visit in daylight hours and keep valuables out of sight; it is an easy stop on foot from the center's main streets.

signature.name: University City of Caracas
signature.detail: A UNESCO-listed modern architecture campus with striking murals and buildings by Carlos Raul Villanueva. Access to some areas is restricted, so go with a guide or on a weekday when the campus is active.

signature.name: Museo de Arte Contemporaneo
signature.detail: One of the region's strongest modern art collections, worth a couple of hours for art lovers. Confirm opening days in advance and allow time to wander the surrounding park area.

transport: Metro under $1 a ride; short taxis a few dollars
